name: solute carrier family 3 member 2

function.text: SLC3A2 encodes amino acid transporter heavy chain SLC3A2. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in L-histidine transport and L-leucine transport.
